body.name: O
body.def: \(\mathcal O(\eta)=\bigl(\operatorname{skel}(M_k(\eta)),\operatorname{UC}(M_k(\eta))\bigr)_{k=0}^{K}\), where both components are taken on the full regime domain \(U_k\). Its \(k=0\) component is the observational signature associated with \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}=\mathcal L_{\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1)\), with no indicator. For every \(k\in[K]\), \(M_k(\eta)\) is interpreted through the pooled selected law \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\), not through either arm law alone, and the signature retains every adjacency and every unshielded collider involving only vertices in \(V\) or involving \(\zeta_k\).
